title: Held-Out Multi-Paper Semantic Benchmark for Local EXTRACT
goal: Build an independently source-verified, held-out multi-paper semantic acceptance benchmark for Local EXTRACT so project success is measured by generalized claim/evidence quality rather than the one-paper 13-atom diagnostic. Keep active EXTRACT development scientifically independent and research-engine read-only while the benchmark corpus, annotation protocol, schemas, pilot annotations, adjudication rules, and final acceptance mapping are developed in workspace-control.
acceptance_criteria: Existing nine-paper EXTRACT corpus is explicitly development/regression data and cannot serve as the final held-out semantic acceptance set.

A fresh primary-research corpus is frozen with at least two annotation-pilot papers and at least eight acceptance-holdout papers spanning open-set/unknown rejection, domain shift/generalization, authentication/security, hardware anomaly/fingerprinting, and real-world dataset/evaluation settings.
Benchmark labels are created source-first from authoritative PDFs without consulting Local EXTRACT outputs.
Every positive obligation carries exact PDF quote/page provenance and a normalized scientific claim; duplicates/overlaps are explicitly adjudicated.
The benchmark can evaluate positive evidence recall and output precision/unsupported claims, not only recall of a positive teacher subset.
Paper-level holdout and label isolation prevent architecture tuning against acceptance gold.
Final acceptance maps back to the original Local EXTRACT hard-safety and production-promotion gates rather than requiring 13/13 on the legacy teacher control.
No research-engine or active EXTRACT architecture mutation is performed by this task.
constraints: Do not alter research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1 or its scientific choices.
Do not run active EXTRACT on acceptance-holdout papers during benchmark construction.
Do not use active EXTRACT outputs to create or revise gold labels.
The legacy nine-paper corpus and 13-atom teacher oracle remain development/regression evidence only.
Pilot papers may be used to debug annotation/schema mechanics but cannot count toward final acceptance.
Acceptance gold labels must be frozen before final Local EXTRACT evaluation on those papers.
The authoritative PDF is the scientific source of truth; abstracts, metadata services, and historical Codex outputs are discovery/seed aids only.
Do not silently treat unlabeled propositions as negative examples.
Unsupported-claim evaluation is performed over system outputs by source adjudication; positive obligation recall alone is insufficient.

Legacy nine-paper corpus and one-paper 13-atom diagnostic oracle.
outputs: Fresh two-pilot/eight-acceptance corpus frozen outside the nine-paper development set.
Source-first semantic benchmark contract with positive-recall and output-precision evaluation.
Gold schema using PDF/page/canonical-span hashes plus short navigation anchors.
Pilot Pass-A obligations demonstrating METHOD, DATASET_SETUP, RESULT/ROBUSTNESS, LIMITATION, CORE/SECONDARY, and COMPOSITE support.

evidence: Two pilot and eight acceptance papers are frozen outside the legacy nine-paper development corpus.
